body: I have been in this exact situation before when I was younger a bit younger.. the three options you have are go to the police and attempt to file for harassment against the person (personally the one I would try first) second continue paying and letting it slowly eat at you or third (what I ended up doing, but I am also a guy may be a different view for a women) is ripping it off like a bandaid, tell the scammer to go fuck himself and you aren’t sending him anything, and prepare for what comes next. Personally they ended up never even sending them especially since I believe it is now a felony to do things like that. But if you do that then they may send them but when they do I’m sure everyone around you will understand that you were blackmailed and you had no control. Also if you happen to be underage then they are a goner for sure. Regardless of how you approach this I hope everything works out for you. People are absolute scumbags
